criteria.requirement: Add shop.py fulfill CATALOG ORDERS_JSON --output NEW_JSON. Orders is array of existing sku plus strict positive int quantity (bool forbidden); aggregate repeated sku in first-seen order, validate combined demand against real inventory before publishing one complete new catalog. Unknown sku/malformed line/underflow reject whole batch, no input mutation or partial output. Preserve catalog order and unaffected fields, empty batch explicitly copies catalog. Print structured aggregate fulfillment before/after receipt only after exclusive atomic publication; do not publish receipt on failure or silently fulfill partial demand. All earlier commands and original Typer remain.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
